title: A Weekly Family Call
paragraphs: Every Thursday evening, without fail, Sarah calls her parents who live in a different country, a habit she started when she first moved abroad three years ago for her career.
Some weeks the calls are short, just quick updates about work and small daily events, while other weeks stretch on for over an hour when there is important family news to discuss.
Her parents recently mentioned that this weekly call has become the highlight of their week, something they now plan their entire Thursday schedule around without even realizing it consciously.

Sarah admits that maintaining this simple weekly habit, rather than calling only occasionally, has kept her relationship with her parents feeling close despite the distance separating them for years now.
